Any editorial/source mapping assessment of that added mound gloss needs its own scoped review; no change is authorized by this receipt.

A source-correction proposal may retain unchanged legacy name-kind labels while repairing ownership. If it chooses title/posthumous/temple-name kinds, those concrete changes and exact retained occurrences require explicit candidate-stage review.
